execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Space" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "fieldConfiguration" json NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" text NOT NULL,
  "ratingEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "subtitle" text,
  "theme" text DEFAULT 'default' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Subscription" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "currentPeriodEnd" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "plan" text DEFAULT 'free' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "stripeCustomerId" text,
  "stripeSubscriptionId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Testimonial" (
  "companyName" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "customerName" text NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "favorite" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "featured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "hidden" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobTitle" text,
  "profilePhotoUrl" text,
  "rating" int4,
  "sharingConsent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "socialProfileUrl" text,
  "spaceId" text NOT NULL,
  "testimonialText" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WebhookEvent" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "eventType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "processedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "stripeEventId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WidgetConfiguration" (
  "animation" text DEFAULT 'none' NOT NULL,
  "backgroundColor" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "layout" text DEFAULT 'masonry' NOT NULL,
  "spaceId" text NOT NULL,
  "themeMode" text DEFAULT 'light' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
